answer: Deposits are visible in willow, and ledge reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 45% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 90 aliases, and each one needs its own funded zenith account. That bill is paid per identity, so 231 aliases cost 144 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
